title: A resolved rebase conflict in a tool file is checked to parse and keep both sides' definitions before land goes on
goal: When land stops at rebase and the session resolves a conflict in a _tools/*.py file, the kb-git-sync and kb-item runbooks say to resolve by hand and to check the file parses and keeps every top-level definition both sides added (a selfdoc or backlog check names any it lost) before land runs again; a test plants a resolution that drops one side's function. Answers the SP-tpulmoxh retrospective: a scripted resolution of bl_check.py dropped both sides' new functions and was caught only by a parse error.
